rules.title: Relocation assistance for no-fault evictions under the RSO and JCO
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting RSO- or JCO-covered tenants for a no-fault reason must pay relocation assistance per unit, based on tenant status, length of tenancy and income. Payment must be made available within 15 days of serving the termination notice, either directly or through an escrow account.
rules.key_value: Jul 1, 2026-Jun 30, 2027: Eligible $11,000 (<3 yrs) / $14,400 (3+ yrs or low income); Qualified $23,150 / $27,400; Mom & Pop (owner/family move-in only) $10,550 eligible / $21,250 qualified; JCO single-family home owned by natural person: one month's rent
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or Just Cause Ordinance (JCO) evicted for a no-fault reason: owner, family or resident-manager move-in; demolition, conversion or withdrawal (Ellis); government order to vacate; HUD sale; residential hotel conversion; conversion to affordable housing. Qualified tenants are those 62 or older, disabled, or with minor dependent children. Low income means at or below 80% AMI.
rules.exemptions: Reduced Mom & Pop amounts apply for owner/relative move-ins only where the building has 4 or fewer units, the landlord owns no more than 4 units plus one single-family home in LA, the provision was not used in the prior 3 years, and the relative owns no LA residential property. A JCO single-family home owned by a natural person who owns no more than 4 units plus one SFD pays one month's rent. No payment is required when replacing one resident manager with another, or for natural-disaster hazards not caused by the landlord. Accumulated unpaid rent may be offset, except for government orders to vacate.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Unit must be covered by the RSO or JCO; the amount depends on tenant age, disability, minor children, length of tenancy and income.

rules.penalty: Tenant may raise non-payment as an affirmative defense to eviction; may file a complaint with LAHD; private right of action.
rules.conflict_note: The effective date shown is for the current amounts table (Jul 1, 2026-Jun 30, 2027); the amounts increase every July 1. The underlying ordinances were in force earlier.

rules.title: Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict and termination notice filing with LAHD
rules.requirement: Before a no-fault eviction of an RSO or JCO unit, the landlord must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD, and may serve the termination notice only after that filing. A copy of the notice must be filed with LAHD within 3 days of service; failure to file the declaration makes the eviction a violation.
rules.key_value: Notice copy filed with LAHD within 3 days of service
rules.coverage_conditions: No-fault evictions from units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance or Just Cause Ordinance.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Unit must be covered by the RSO or JCO.

rules.penalty: Eviction without the filed declaration is a violation of the RSO or JCO.

rules.title: Relocation assistance for demolition or condominium/commercial conversion regardless of RSO/JCO coverage
rules.requirement: Landlords who demolish a property or convert it to condominiums, stock cooperatives, community apartments, hotels or commercial use must pay relocation assistance, whether or not the property is subject to the RSO or JCO. Once a condo conversion tract map is approved, tenants may elect to relocate and still receive relocation assistance.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants displaced by demolition or conversion of residential rental property in the City of Los Angeles.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only when the property is being demolished or converted.

rules.title: Resident Protections Ordinance relocation and occupant protections for demolition of Protected Units
rules.requirement: Owners who demolish a Protected Unit for new construction within 5 years of filing a withdrawal or eviction notice must pay enhanced relocation to lower-income tenants (standardized, comparable-replacement or individualized option). Tenants also get the right to remain up to 6 months before construction, the right to return, a right of first refusal and notification.
rules.key_value: Standardized payments Jul 1, 2026-Jun 30, 2027: Extremely Low Income $115,480; Very Low $96,750; Low $87,450; above low income gets the RSO/JCO amounts
rules.coverage_conditions: Protected Units demolished for new construction. Protected Units include all RSO units, units with affordability covenants or rent control in the past 5 years, units rented by lower-income households in the past 5 years, and units Ellis-withdrawn in the past 10 years. Enhanced amounts go only to lower-income (80% AMI or below) households.
rules.exemptions: Households above low income receive only the RSO/JCO Chart A amounts.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: RESTRICTED: Enhanced relocation applies only to lower-income (80% AMI or below) households in Protected Units demolished for new construction.

rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.

rules.title: Housing Crisis Act relocation for lower-income households displaced by demolition for new construction
rules.requirement: Lower-income households displaced by demolition of their units for replacement with new construction must receive relocation benefits equal to those public entities must pay under Gov. Code § 7260 et seq.
rules.coverage_conditions: Lower-income (80% AMI or below) households displaced by demolition of Protected Units for new construction.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: RESTRICTED: Applies only to lower-income households in protected units demolished for new housing development.
